extraction_notes: Synthetic filament tow of aramid (a polyamide) — bundle of parallel continuous filaments destined to be cut into staple. Aramids used in flame-resistant, ballistic, industrial textiles.
Nylon/other polyamide filament tow — other (non-aramid). Generic nylon 6/6,6 tow for cut-to-staple processing.
Polyester filament tow — PET/PBT bundle for cut-to-staple. India is a major polyester-staple producer (Reliance, IOC).
Acrylic/modacrylic filament tow — typically for wool-substitute staple used in sweaters, blankets, awnings. Modacrylic adds flame resistance.
Polypropylene filament tow — destined for cut-to-staple PP fibre (hygiene products, geotextiles, carpets).
Polypropylene tow under 5501.90 residual subheading (India retained a specific PP line here in addition to 5501.40 — possible India-specific duplication; described identically).
Other synthetic filament tow not specified in 5501.11-40 (e.g., polyethylene, PTFE, other niche synthetics).
Viscose rayon tow — cellulose-acetate-based artificial filament tow destined for cut-to-staple viscose staple (Grasim Birla Cellulose is a leading Indian producer).
Other artificial filament tow of cellulose acetate (acetate, triacetate other than viscose) for cut-to-staple.
Viscose rayon tow under 5502.90 residual subheading — India-specific retention.
Other artificial filament tow not specified — lyocell, cupro, modal-precursor tows.
Aramid flame-retardant staple fibre — India-specific 8-digit line (Nomex/meta-aramid type) for FR workwear, oil-rig coveralls.
Para-aramid staple (Kevlar/Twaron type) — ballistic vests, cut-resistant gloves, brake-pad/tyre reinforcement. India-specific 8-digit line.
Other aramid staple fibre — generic aramid not specifically FR-grade or para-aramid.
Generic nylon staple fibre (non-aramid) — nylon 6 / nylon 6,6 cut staple for spinning.
Nylon anti-static staple — conductive carbon-core or chemically modified nylon for ESD workwear, cleanroom textiles. India-specific 8-digit line.
Nylon 66 staple conforming to IS 13464 (BIS standard for high-tenacity nylon 66 fibre) — India-specific 8-digit line.
Other nylon/polyamide staple fibre not elsewhere specified.
Polyester staple fibre (PSF) — backbone of Indian poly-cotton/PV blended-yarn industry. High volume.
Pre-oxidised PAN/acrylic fibre conforming to IS 17308 — stabilised PAN intermediate used in FR fabrics (firefighter hoods) and as precursor to carbon fibre. India-specific 8-digit line.
Other acrylic/modacrylic staple — standard PAN acrylic for sweaters, blankets, shawls (India: Pasupati, Indian Acrylics).
Polyvinyl (PVA/vinylon) staple fibre — water-soluble or cement-reinforcement fibre. India-specific 8-digit line.
Polyvinyl chloride (PVC/chlorofibre) staple — flame-resistant, chemical-resistant niche fibre. India-specific.
UHMWPE staple (Dyneema/Spectra type) conforming to ASTM F2848 — extreme tensile-strength fibre for body armour, cut-resistant gloves, deep-sea ropes. India-specific 8-digit line.
Other synthetic staple fibre not elsewhere specified (e.g., PTFE, PPS, melamine).
FR viscose rayon staple from wood pulp (non-bamboo source) — Lenzing FR/Viscose-FR for fire-blocker linings, FR bedding. India-specific 8-digit line with bamboo/non-bamboo split.
Other viscose rayon staple from wood pulp (non-bamboo) — standard VSF for India's domestic spinning industry.
FR bamboo-source viscose rayon — eco-marketed FR fibre from bamboo pulp. India-specific 8-digit line capturing bamboo provenance.
Other bamboo-source viscose rayon staple — eco-positioned bamboo viscose for apparel.
Other viscose rayon staple — residual under 5504.10 (sources/grades not in 11/19/21/29).
Acetate rayon staple — cellulose acetate cut fibre, used in linings, dress fabrics. India-specific 8-digit line.
Polynosic staple — modal-style high-wet-modulus viscose fibre, premium shirting/dressing weight. India-specific 8-digit line.
High-wet-modulus staple fibre (HWM rayon / modal) — Lenzing Modal type, silky-soft premium apparel fibre. India-specific 8-digit line.
Other artificial staple fibre not specified — lyocell/Tencel, cupro residuals.
Acrylic synthetic-fibre waste — noils, yarn waste, garnetted stock under 5505.10 (synthetic fibres). India-specific 8-digit acrylic line; Panipat shoddy-yarn industry consumer.
Other synthetic fibre waste — polyester/nylon/PP noils, yarn waste, garnetted material for re-spinning.
Artificial fibre waste — viscose/acetate noils, yarn waste, garnetted material.
Carded/combed nylon staple — synthetic staple processed for spinning (vs raw uncarded 5503).
Carded/combed polyester staple — PSF prepared for ring/rotor spinning.
Carded/combed acrylic/modacrylic staple — prepared for knitwear-yarn spinning.
Carded/combed polypropylene staple — prepared for spinning (carpets, geotextiles).
Polypropylene tops — combed sliver wound as worsted tops for spinning. India-specific 8-digit line.
Other carded/combed synthetic staple not specified.
Acetate rayon tops — combed acetate staple in worsted-tops form. India-specific 8-digit line.
Viscose tops — combed VSF in worsted-tops form. India-specific 8-digit line.
Polynosic tops — modal-style HWM viscose combed in tops form. India-specific 8-digit line.
High-wet-modulus (modal) tops — combed Lenzing-Modal-type staple in worsted-tops form. India-specific 8-digit line.
Other carded/combed artificial staple not specified.
Sewing thread of synthetic staple — polyester/nylon spun sewing thread (vs filament-thread which falls under 5401).
Sewing thread of artificial staple — viscose/acetate spun sewing thread.
